read_when: the user asks to reference design docs, specs, implementation standards, checklists, scenarios, or validation criteria
the task involves product rules, domain behavior, UX flow, API contracts, data modeling, or system design
code, config, and tests are not enough to infer implementation intent or success criteria
existing implementation may conflict with project docs
do_not_read_when: formatting, small rename, or file move
the user already gave concrete implementation criteria
